name: 80s Arcade
summary: 8-bit arcade cabinet: deep indigo ground, neon pink/cyan/yellow, hard 4px pixel borders, and Press Start 2P display type.
whenToUse: When the user asks for 80s arcade, 8-bit, NES, pixel-art, neon arcade HUD, or a retro game-cabinet aesthetic.
rules: Treat 4px as the pixel unit: every border, inset, outset, ring, and gap derives from it (4/8/12/16px) — never 1px hairlines, 2px borders, or 3px insets.
Elevate with hard offset shadows only, zero blur (4px 4px 0 #7c1dfd, 8px 8px 0 8px #7c1dfd); never soft or blurred drop shadows — the single exception is the 0 0 8px #00e5ff HUD glow.
Use Press Start 2P for headings, buttons, and HUD labels only; set all body copy, table cells, and input values in VT323 — the 8px pixel font is unreadable at paragraph length.
Uppercase display type with letter-spacing 0.05em–0.15em, and keep display strings to a few words so the tracking does not shred them.
Pixelate imagery: image-rendering: pixelated, no anti-aliasing, integer scale factors only, and snap every column and row to the 8px grid (4px sub-steps allowed).
Animate discretely: steps(8, end) easing, linear coin spin, and instant :active press physics (translate by the offset, collapse the shadow) at 0/150/300/1500ms — never smooth cubic-bezier fades.
Build the pixel-border panel as a 4px solid border plus stacked offset rings (0 0 0 4px background, 0 0 0 8px accent) plus a hard offset drop — the rings are the look, not an optional flourish.
Spend one neon per component: pink #ff2d95 for primary action and selection, cyan #00e5ff for focus and live HUD trim, yellow #ffd300 for highlights and score values.

componentRecipes.card: background:#1a1440; border:4px solid #e9e9ff; border-radius:0; padding:16px 24px; color:#e9e9ff; box-shadow:0 0 0 4px #0b0b1e, 0 0 0 8px #ff2d95, 8px 8px 0 8px #7c1dfd; header = Press Start 2P 12px uppercase #ffd300 with a 4px #ff2d95 underline, body = VT323 20px/1.4 #e9e9ff, and a footer action row of 4px-bordered buttons; one neon per card, hover lifts translate(-2px,-2px) and widens the offset shadow.
componentRecipes.select: A HUD toggle, not a native dropdown: trigger is a Press Start 2P 12px uppercase plate (background:#0b0b1e;border:4px solid #adafbc;padding:12px 16px;color:#e9e9ff) with a blinking '▼' in #00e5ff; the open list is a stacked-ring panel of VT323 rows where the selected row inverts to #ff2d95 with #0b0b1e text and prefixes '►'; hover hard-offsets the row 4px and focus keeps the 4px cyan outline.
componentRecipes.checkbox: Square 24px pixel well: background:#0b0b1e;border:4px solid #adafbc;border-radius:0; the checked state fills a 12px #ffd300 block centred inside with a 4px #ff2d95 ring on focus; radio variant uses a 12px #ff2d95 dot instead; label sits in VT323 20px #e9e9ff and the state is repeated as 'ON'/'OFF' in Press Start 2P.
componentRecipes.badge: A 4px-bordered pixel chip: display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:6px 10px;background:#0b0b1e;border:4px solid;border-radius:0;font:10px/1 'Press Start 2P';text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.08em; role color = border+text (#2bff88 success, #f7d51d warning, #ff3b3b danger, #ffd300 neutral) with the word spelled out; never rounded, never icon-only.
componentRecipes.avatar: A 32px pixel tile: image-rendering:pixelated; background:#0b0b1e; border:4px solid #e9e9ff; border-radius:0; box-shadow:4px 4px 0 #7c1dfd; initials fall back to a centred Press Start 2P 12px glyph in #ffd300; integer 2x/3x scale only, and the tile snaps to the 8px grid.
componentRecipes.nav: Horizontal HUD rail: items are Press Start 2P 12px uppercase #e9e9ff with 4px 0 16px padding and a 4px #7c1dfd separator; hover inverts the label to #00e5ff; the active tab paints a 4px #ffd300 underline that stops one grid step short and prefixes a blinking '▮'; the vertical menu form is the existing menu recipe; no radius and no smooth motion.
componentRecipes.table: 4px pixel table: header row = Press Start 2P 10px uppercase #ffd300 on #0b0b1e with a 4px #e9e9ff bottom border; body rows = VT323 20px/1.4 #e9e9ff on #1a1440 separated by 4px #adafbc rules; hover inverts to #00e5ff, the selected row inverts to background #ff2d95 / text #0b0b1e and prefixes '►'; cell padding 8px 12px, radius 0, no zebra opacity.
componentRecipes.dialog: A stacked-ring modal: background:#1a1440;border:4px solid #e9e9ff;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px #0b0b1e, 0 0 0 8px #ff2d95, 8px 8px 0 8px #7c1dfd; the scrim is color-mix(in srgb, var(--overlay) 60%, transparent) over the page; title in Press Start 2P uppercase, body in VT323, and a Press Start 2P action row at the bottom; entrance is a 150ms steps(8) translate from -8px, focus stays trapped.
componentRecipes.toast: Bottom-right HUD alert: background:#0b0b1e;border:4px solid;padding:12px 16px;font:VT323 20px/1.2;border-radius:0; a 4px left accent in the role color (#2bff88/#f7d51d/#ff3b3b) plus the word (SCORED, WARNING, ERROR); auto-dismisses in 300ms by collapsing its 4px 4px 0 #7c1dfd shadow to 0, and reduced motion shows it statically.
componentRecipes.code: A pixel monospace block: background:#0b0b1e;border:4px solid #e9e9ff;border-radius:0;padding:16px;font:18px/1.5 'VT323'; color:#e9e9ff; preserve whitespace; comments in #adafbc, strings in #ffd300, and errors in #ff3b3b; no syntax gradients, and the block keeps the 4px cyan focus ring when tabbed.
componentRecipes.empty: A centred pixel panel (panel recipe) with an 8-bit sprite motif drawn in 4px blocks (#ff2d95/#00e5ff/#ffd300), one VT323 message ('INSERT COIN' / 'NO SAVES'), and a single Press Start 2P primary button; the motif is aria-hidden and the message names the empty state in words.
componentRecipes.panel: background: #1a1440; border: 4px solid #e9e9ff; border-radius: 0; padding: 16px 24px; color: #e9e9ff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #0b0b1e, 0 0 0 8px #ff2d95, 8px 8px 0 8px #7c1dfd; — the dark inner ring is what separates the pixel border from the neon ring; drop the outer 8px ring below 640px. Optional inner scanline overlay from effects.scanlines at 100% cover, pointer-events: none.
componentRecipes.button: font: 700 12px/1.4 'Press Start 2P'; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; background: #ffd300; color: #0b0b1e; border: 4px solid #0b0b1e; border-radius: 0; padding: 12px 16px; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #7c1dfd, 0 0 0 4px #e9e9ff; transition: none; :hover { transform: translate(-2px, -2px); box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 #7c1dfd, 0 0 0 4px #e9e9ff; } :active { transform: translate(4px, 4px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 #7c1dfd, 0 0 0 4px #e9e9ff; } :focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #00e5ff; outline-offset: 4px; } — secondary variant: #1a1440 background, #e9e9ff text, 0 0 0 4px #ff2d95 ring.
componentRecipes.input: background: #0b0b1e; color: #e9e9ff; font: 20px/1.4 'VT323'; border: 4px solid #adafbc; border-radius: 0; padding: 8px 12px; caret-color: #00e5ff; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 4px #1a1440; :placeholder { color: #adafbc; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; font-family: 'Press Start 2P'; font-size: 10px; } :focus { border-color: #00e5ff; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 4px #1a1440, 0 0 8px #00e5ff; outline: none; } — invalid state: border-color #ff3b3b with a VT323 uppercase message below, always accompanied by the word ERROR.
componentRecipes.statusbar: height: 32px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; padding: 0 16px; background: #1a1440; border-top: 4px solid #00e5ff; border-radius: 0; font: 10px/1 'Press Start 2P'; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: #e9e9ff; segments separated by border-left: 4px solid #7c1dfd; live value in #ffd300, warning in #f7d51d, critical in #ff3b3b; the trailing prompt is an 8px wide #00e5ff block animated with steps(2, jump-none) 1s infinite.
componentRecipes.menu: vertical list, no radius, no bullets: item { display: block; font: 12px/1.5 'Press Start 2P'; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 8px 16px 8px 32px; color: #e9e9ff; } selected item inverts to background #ff2d95 / color #0b0b1e and prefixes a blinking '>' in #ffd300 at 32px steps(2, jump-none) 1s infinite; hover shifts translate(-4px, -4px) with box-shadow 4px 4px 0 #7c1dfd; group separators are 4px dashed #7c1dfd, never 1px hairlines.

copywriting.voice: Coin-op cabinet HUD: clipped, loud, second-person imperative. Short uppercase commands, score-like numerals, and zero corporate politeness — the machine is talking to a player, not a customer.

case.body: UPPERCASE for HUD labels and buttons; sentence case only for running paragraphs of VT323 body copy

avoid: stacked punctuation (!!!, ???) and all-caps sentences in VT323 body
Press Start 2P for any string longer than a few words
mixed-case labels in the HUD or on buttons
apologetic loading copy ('Sorry, just a moment')

do: Quantize every border, padding step, and grid line to 4px or 8px multiples so the pixel unit stays honest across components.
Pair neon with the deep indigo ground (#0b0b1e, #1a1440) — the same pink or cyan on white reads as modern, not arcade.
Give every interactive element a hard offset shadow plus a discrete pressed state so clicks feel like cabinet buttons snapping down.
Set HUD labels, headings, and buttons in Press Start 2P uppercase at 0.05em–0.15em letter-spacing, and keep them to a few words.
Use the stacked-ring panel (0 0 0 4px background, 0 0 0 8px accent, then hard drop) as the default container instead of a flat bordered card.
Keep a 4px cyan (#00e5ff) focus outline at 4px offset on every focusable element, and hold that state steady rather than blinking it.
dont: No border-radius anywhere — 0 on buttons, inputs, panels, images, and avatars.
No smooth motion: no ease-in-out, no cubic-bezier fades, no animated blur transitions — and no blurred shadows beyond the single cyan HUD glow.
No Press Start 2P body copy: paragraphs, table cells, help text, and long values belong to VT323.
No gradients or glassmorphism on surfaces, no backdrop-blur, no semi-transparent overlays over the neon.
No 1px hairlines, 2px borders, or 3px insets — the smallest line weight in the system is 4px.
No white or pastel page backgrounds, and no mixing two neon accents on one component as decoration.
accessibility: Body text #e9e9ff on #0b0b1e clears 4.5:1 easily, but #ff2d95 and #00e5ff on #1a1440 do not — reserve those neons for large bold type, borders, or non-text signal, and verify every pairing before shipping.
Press Start 2P only reads from 10px up with 1.4–1.6 line-height and a few words per line; VT323 carries all running text at 20px/1.4 minimum with no fake bold or italic.
Honor prefers-reduced-motion: stop the blinking cursor, coin spin, and scanline drift, and render the :active shadow collapse as an instant state change rather than an animation.
Never encode state by color alone — pair each neon with a label (HI-SCORE, GAME OVER, ERROR, READY) and keep a visible 4px focus ring on every focusable element.
signatureElement: The pixel-border panel (4px solid border wrapped in stacked offset rings) and the press-physics button (hard offset shadow that collapses on :active)

prose.overview: 80s Arcade renders the interface as a coin-op cabinet: a deep indigo ground, neon pink/cyan/yellow signals, and hard 4px pixel borders that read as sprite work rather than drawn UI. Everything is quantized — a 4px pixel unit, an 8px layout grid, zero radius, stepped motion — so the surface looks emitted by hardware instead of styled by a designer. It should feel loud, dense, and playable, never glossy.
prose.colors: The ground is near-black indigo (#0b0b1e) with panels one step up at #1a1440; #e9e9ff carries body text and #adafbc is the only muted tone. Neon is signal, not decoration: pink #ff2d95 for primary action and selection, cyan #00e5ff for focus, glow, and HUD trim, yellow #ffd300 for highlights and score values, with green #2bff88, red #ff3b3b, and purple #7c1dfd reserved for success, danger, and shadow rings. The nested NES ramps (default/primary/success/warning/error triads) and the 64-entry NES palette provide shading steps for sprites and are consumed as ramps, not as flat replacements for the role colors.
prose.typography: Press Start 2P is the cabinet voice — headings, buttons, HUD labels, scores, and the hero wordmark — always uppercase and tracked out 0.05em–0.15em. VT323 carries every sentence: body copy, table cells, help text, and input values, because the 8px pixel face collapses at paragraph length. Both are monospaced and grid-locked, so line-heights land on 4px increments (16px, 24px) and no italic, weight, or letter-spacing variation is faked to create hierarchy.
prose.layout: The layout is a fixed sprite grid: an 8px grid with 4px sub-steps, spacing tokens of 4/8/16/24/32px, and panels aligned to those columns instead of optically nudged. Content sits inside centred HUD frames with a persistent status bar and menu rail, so the interface reads like a screen with a bezel — title band on top, play field in the middle, score and controls at the bottom. Nothing floats: panels butt against grid edges behind 4px borders, and no gutter is ever smaller than the border weight.
prose.elevation: Depth is drawn, not lit: elevation is a zero-blur hard offset shadow — 4px 4px 0 for buttons and rows, 8px 8px 0 8px #7c1dfd for hero panels — and pressing an element translates it by that offset while the shadow collapses to nothing. Panels stack a dark ring then a neon ring around their border (0 0 0 4px #0b0b1e, 0 0 0 8px #ff2d95) before the drop, which is what produces the chunky pixel-border look. The only tolerated blur in the system is the 8px cyan HUD glow, used for focus and live readouts.
prose.shapes: Every shape is a square-cornered rectangle: radius 0, 4px borders, no pills, no arcs, no circles except sprites drawn as boxes. Icons and imagery are pixel art rendered with image-rendering: pixelated and scaled by integer factors (2x, 3x, 4x) so no anti-aliased edge ever appears. Corners are chamfered by removing whole 4px blocks from a border, never by rounding it.
prose.components: Panels use the stacked-ring recipe — 4px solid border, dark ring, neon ring, hard offset drop — and are the default container; hero headings are the same recipe at 32px padding with a Press Start 2P wordmark at 24–32px and a 4px #ffd300 underline rule. Buttons are 4px-bordered Press Start 2P plates on #ffd300 with a 4px 4px 0 purple shadow that translates away on :active. Inputs are square 4px-bordered wells set in VT323 that switch to a cyan border and HUD glow on focus, the status bar is a 32px strip of uppercase Press Start 2P segments split by 4px rules, and menus are vertical item lists where the selected row inverts to pink and shows a blinking '>' marker.
prose.dosDonts: Do quantize everything to 4px and 8px, do invert selected rows instead of outlining them, and do give every interactive element an instant pressed state. Don't round a corner, don't blur a shadow, don't set a paragraph in Press Start 2P, and don't lift the indigo ground toward white — neon only works against the dark.
